category_title: Students with narcolepsy experiencing cognitive slowness and impaired communication
minimal_context: The student is taking a theoretical subject exam while seated in a large group classroom setting.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please begin working on your history exam now that the whole class is seated.

STUDENT: I don't... I forgot how to answer these. I knew this before, but the skills are just lost.

TUTOR: Read the questions again and see what you can remember.

STUDENT: I can't concentrate with everyone in here... I'm having a fatigue attack.

TUTOR: Just try to stay awake and finish the test.

STUDENT: (Speech is slurred and unclear) Can't... think... (puts head down on the desk, unable to continue functioning)

options.A: Schedule theoretical subjects and exams in the morning, and practical subjects in the afternoon.
options.B: Secure and participate in family counseling for the student through the Department of Human Services.
options.C: Establish, through consensus, the working practices of the large group via a classroom pledge and reinforce it.
options.D: Provide positive reports home or positive feedback to the student's parents regarding their academic progress.
